approval_note: DRAFT engineering checkpoints, not qualified acceptance limits or safety standards. Obtain approved test methods, fixture and instrument calibration, optical viewing-grid coverage, limits and uncertainty budgets before using physical results as release evidence.

cases.method: Measure carrier protected supply at idle under nominal input; use qualified test points and calibrated DMM.
Measure controller 3.3 V rail; limits are provisional engineering targets.
Capture minimum protected supply with Wi-Fi TX, display and intended maximum LED/audio load; retain complete calibrated acquisition, not a DMM average.
Proposed touch-surface engineering target at declared ambient/load after defined thermal equilibrium; not a regulatory temperature limit.

Proposed (Lbright/Ldark) ratio at each approved teller eye position and ambient condition, measured with a calibrated luminance method. This single checkpoint is not the required viewing-volume qualification.

Proposed absolute text-on versus text-off luminance modulation divided by background luminance; qualify dark-floor handling, nonlinear sensor effects and every client eye position. Does not alone prove text unreadability.
